units.source_text: 此时贺茂神社里那位斋院，已经修行期满。

en.t: At this time, the Saiin at Kamo Shrine had already completed her term of religious training.

units.source_text: 继任之人，卜定了弘徽殿太后所生的三公主。

en.t: For her successor, divination selected the Third Princess, born to the Empress Dowager of Kokiden.

units.source_text: 桐壶帝与弘徽殿太后特别宠爱这公主，

en.t: Emperor Kiritsubo and the Empress Dowager of Kokiden were especially fond of this princess,

units.source_text: 舍不得放她去度清苦的修行生活。

en.t: and could hardly bear to send her away to live the austere life of religious training.

units.source_text: 然而此外没有适当之人，也只得割慈忍爱。

en.t: However, since there was no one else suitable, they had no choice but to suppress their affection and endure the parting.

units.source_text: 斋院入社的仪式，本是通常的神事，但此次特别隆重。

en.t: The ceremony for the Saiin entering the shrine was normally an ordinary Shinto rite, but this time it was especially grand.

units.source_text: 贺茂神社祝祭，除了规定的仪式之外，又增添许多节目，花样十分新颖。

en.t: At the Kamo Shrine festival, many entertainments were added besides the prescribed rites, and the arrangements were quite novel.

units.source_text: 这原是按照斋院的身份高下而有繁简之别的。

en.t: This was because the scale of such ceremonies traditionally varied according to the Saiin's rank and status.
